name: ScriptSeen
short_description: Write short-form scripts, hear a paced read, and prepare a private video project.
description: ScriptSeen turns a topic and audience into a timed script for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts. Generate paced reference audio with sentence timing, then open a private project in ScriptSeen's browser studio to select your own clips and render locally. Video preparation returns a browser handoff, not a finished MP4. Script generation and new audio reads use the connected user's ScriptSeen plan allowances.
authentication: OAuth authorization code with S256 PKCE; dynamic client registration; scoped consent; one-hour access tokens; rotating refresh tokens with a 30-day connection lifetime; user revocation.
starter_prompts: Write a 30-second Reel for new creators about filming in natural window light.
Generate a paced reference read for this ScriptSeen script.
Prepare this ScriptSeen project for a video using clips on my device.
limitations: No coaching, billing, account administration or saved-library access.
No clip upload or server-side video rendering.
OAuth does not currently support OpenID Connect or enterprise email-domain restrictions.
publisher_identity: Select the actual verified publisher in the portal; do not infer a legal company name.
reviewer_access: Provision a dedicated reviewer account; supply credentials only through the vendor's protected reviewer channel.
availability: Confirm the service's supported regions against provider and marketplace requirements during submission.
